Subject: Post-signature onboarding trajectory & embedded MAP — Sparrow Technologies

Hi Alicia / Marco —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get Sparrow live. Per our conversation, I attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan: rollout phases, canary schedule, migration windows, and the training curriculum. This is intentionally high-level so we can agree cadence and owners before we iterate into the delivery sprint plan.

Key goals for this MAP (proposal):
- Production readiness within 8 weeks from signature with a 2-week canary phase.
- Zero customer-impact migration (blue/green with traffic steering).
- Knowledge transfer: 2 instructor-led sessions + 3 office hours in week 1.

Please review the MAP_v1.xlsx I attached. Specific asks for Sparrow to confirm by EOD Tuesday:
1) Preferred canary start window (options: week of Apr 28, May 5).
2) Primary and backup migration owners on your side (names + emails).
3) Any mandatory blackout dates in May.

Internal owners: Laura will run the canary program, Priyom will lead migration engineering, Kimberly will coordinate training. I'll own overall execution and escalation path.

I'll follow up tomorrow with a suggested weekly cadence and a short kickoff agenda.

Thanks,
Sergio

--

Adding a quick engineering note after an infra sync with the runtime team:
- Suggested migration approach: blue/green with session affinity off and KV prefix-based warmup for 48 hours. This reduces user-visible flapping and simplifies rollback.
- Canary targets: start at 2% traffic for 2 hours, then 10% for 6 hours, then 30% for 24 hours if SLOs are met.
- Monitoring hooks: token-level latency histogram exposure and a canary-only tracing tag (so Sparrow can validate handler-level tail latency).

I'll draft the migration-checklist with these specifics. Also creating an abridged ops runbook (canary-runbook-sparrow.pdf) so we have a single source of truth for the day-of play.

Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Best,
